name: @zaisma/input
summary: Input for every device: keyboard and mouse, touch and gamepads read as one set of actions the game names, plus where the player moves and how far they turn the view, so a game plays on a phone, a laptop and a controller with no handling of its own for each.

settings.name: input_enabled
settings.summary: Whether the player's input is read. Turned off (while a menu or a chat box is open), moving and turning stop, every action is let go and the page's own keys work again.

settings.name: mouse_look_mode
settings.summary: How the mouse turns the view: pointer_lock hides the pointer on a click and every move turns; hold_button turns only while mouse_look_button is held, keeping the pointer for menus; off leaves the mouse to the game.

settings.name: mouse_look_button
settings.summary: The mouse button held to turn the view when mouse_look_mode is hold_button.

settings.name: mouse_look_rad_per_px
settings.summary: How far the view turns for each pixel the mouse moves, in radians: the mouse sensitivity.

settings.name: raw_mouse_enabled
settings.summary: Whether a locked mouse is read as it moves, without the computer's pointer acceleration, where the browser allows it, so the same hand movement always turns the same amount.

settings.name: invert_look_y_enabled
settings.summary: Whether pushing up looks down, on every device.

settings.name: touch_controls_enabled
settings.summary: Whether the piece draws its touch controls (the stick and a button for each action with a touch label). Off, touches still move and turn the view, and the game draws its own buttons and presses actions with setTouchHeld.

settings.name: touch_stick_radius_px
settings.summary: How far the thumb moves from where it landed to push the stick all the way, in CSS pixels.

settings.name: touch_stick_dead_zone_pct
settings.summary: How much of the stick's radius a thumb moves before the character starts to move, so a resting thumb stands still.

settings.name: touch_stick_follows_enabled
settings.summary: Whether the stick follows a thumb that slides past its edge, so turning back responds at once instead of crossing the whole stick.

settings.name: touch_stick_zone_pct
settings.summary: How much of the screen's width, from the left, starts the stick where a thumb lands; a touch anywhere else turns the view.

settings.name: touch_look_rad_per_px
settings.summary: How far the view turns for each pixel a finger drags, in radians.

settings.name: touch_button_size_px
settings.summary: How wide the first touch button is, in CSS pixels; the others are a little smaller around it.

settings.name: gamepad_move_dead_zone_pct
settings.summary: How far the move stick is pushed before the character moves, so a worn stick never drifts. Past it, moving starts from nothing.

settings.name: gamepad_look_dead_zone_pct
settings.summary: How far the look stick is pushed before the view turns.

settings.name: gamepad_look_rad_per_sec
settings.summary: How fast the view turns with the look stick pushed all the way, in radians a second.

settings.name: gamepad_fine_aim_pct
settings.summary: How much finer small pushes of the look stick are than big ones, for aiming: at 0 the view turns as far as the stick is pushed; higher keeps small pushes slow while a full push still turns at full speed (the push is raised to the power 1 + 3 × this ÷ 100).

settings.name: gamepad_trigger_press_pct
settings.summary: How far a trigger is pulled before an action bound to it is held. How far it's pulled is always read with pressedPctOf.

settings.name: gamepad_sticks_swapped_enabled
settings.summary: Whether the right stick moves and the left one turns the view, for players who hold it that way.

settings.name: gamepad_label_style
settings.summary: Which controller's names labelsOf gives gamepad buttons: auto names them after the gamepad in the player's hands.

settings.name: rumble_enabled
settings.summary: Whether rumble shakes a gamepad, or a phone that can vibrate. Off, rumble does nothing.

hooks.name: device_changed
hooks.summary: Told during update when the player starts using another kind of device, with its kind: keyboard_mouse, touch or gamepad. Change the prompts on screen here.

hooks.name: action_pressed
hooks.summary: Told during update when an action is pressed, with { actionName, deviceKind }, in the order the game named its actions.

hooks.name: action_released
hooks.summary: Told during update when an action is let go, with { actionName, deviceKind }.

hooks.name: pointer_lock_changed
hooks.summary: Told when the pointer is locked to the game or let go (the player pressed Escape), with whether it's locked now. Show a click-to-play prompt here.

hooks.name: before_move
hooks.summary: Asked during update with where the player wants to move, { x, y }; answer another { x, y } to change it (reversed controls, a slow while aiming), or nothing to leave it. Its length is kept to 1 at most.

hooks.name: before_look
hooks.summary: Asked during update with how far the player turned the view this frame in radians, { x, y }; answer another { x, y } to change it (a slower turn while aiming, aim assist), or nothing to leave it.
